body: Shirt, shorts, socks, shinguards, footwear.

title: The Players' Equipment — Colours
body: Distinct from opponents and match officials.

body: Non-dangerous additional items; goalkeeper tracksuit bottoms.

title: The Players' Equipment — Colours and designs
body: Slogans, logos and permitted markings.

title: The Referee
body: IFAB Law 5 — The Referee. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: The Referee — Powers and duties
body: Enforce the Laws; disciplinary action; report.

title: The Referee — Decisions
body: Final on facts of play; may not change after restart in most cases.

title: The Referee — Powers regarding offences
body: Stop, suspend or abandon for outside interference.

title: The Referee — Advantage
body: Allow play to continue when benefit exists; caution later if needed.

title: The Referee — Injury
body: Stop for serious injury; allow treatment; restart dropped ball if contested.

title: The Referee — Outside agents
body: Ball boys, spectators, objects on the field.

title: The Referee — Video assistant referee
body: Referee may use VAR information per protocol.

body: Administrative duties, substitutions, added time signal.

title: The Other Match Officials — Additional assistant referees
body: Goal-line and penalty area support where used.

body: Flag signals for offside, fouls, substitutions.

body: Technical area, benches, communication.

body: VAR and AVAR roles per protocol.

body: Headsets and procedures between officials.

title: The Duration of the Match — Periods of play
body: Two equal halves; duration set by competition.

title: The Duration of the Match — Half-time interval
body: Must not exceed 15 minutes unless competition rules.

title: The Duration of the Match — Allowance for time lost
body: Added time for substitutions, injuries, VAR, etc.

title: The Duration of the Match — Penalty kick at end of period
body: PK taken even if time expires before kick.

title: The Duration of the Match — Abandoned match
body: Competition rules decide outcome.

title: The Start and Restart of Play — Kick-off
body: Start of each half and after goals; ball in play when kicked.

title: The Start and Restart of Play — Dropped ball
body: Restart when play stopped and no other restart applies.

body: Incorrect procedure on restarts.

title: The Ball In and Out of Play — Ball out of play
body: Whole ball over the line; on ground or in air.

title: The Ball In and Out of Play — Ball in play
body: From kick-off, restarts, and when it rebounds from posts, crossbar, officials.

title: Determining the Outcome of a Match
body: IFAB Law 10 — Determining the Outcome of a Match. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: Determining the Outcome of a Match — Goal scored
body: Whole ball over the goal line between posts and under crossbar.

title: Determining the Outcome of a Match — Winning team
body: Team scoring more goals wins.

body: Procedure when competition requires a winner.

title: Offside
body: IFAB Law 11 — Offside. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: Offside — Offside position
body: Nearer opponents' goal line than ball and second-last opponent.

title: Offside — Offside offence
body: Involvement in active play from an offside position.

title: Offside — No offence
body: Level with second-last opponent; in own half; from goal kick, throw-in, corner.

title: Fouls and Misconduct
body: IFAB Law 12 — Fouls and Misconduct. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: Fouls and Misconduct — Direct free kick
body: Careless, reckless or excessive force; handball; holding; etc.

title: Fouls and Misconduct — Indirect free kick
body: Dangerous play, impeding, dissent, goalkeeper offences.

title: Fouls and Misconduct — Disciplinary action
body: Cautions, send-offs, advantage and DOGSO.

title: Fouls and Misconduct — Restart after fouls
body: Free kicks, penalty kicks, dropped ball as appropriate.

title: Denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity
body: Send-off or caution depending on offence type and whether the challenge was an attempt to play the ball.

title: Handling the ball
body: Deliberate hand/arm contact, unnaturally enlarged body, or scoring/handling offences; upper arm boundary at armpit.

title: Violent conduct
body: Using or attempting excessive force or brutality when not challenging for the ball.

title: Direct free kick — careless, reckless or excessive force
body: A direct free kick is awarded if a player commits a physical offence against an opponent in a careless or reckless manner, or uses excessive force or brutality.

title: Serious foul play
body: A tackle or challenge that endangers the safety of an opponent, or uses excessive force or brutality, is sanctioned as serious foul play.

title: Disciplinary action
body: Cautions and send-offs for offences including unsporting behaviour, serious foul play, violent conduct and dissent.

title: Free Kicks
body: IFAB Law 13 — Free Kicks. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: Free Kicks — Types of free kick
body: Direct and indirect free kicks.

title: Free Kicks — Direct free kick procedure
body: Ball stationary; opponents 9.15 m away.

title: Free Kicks — Indirect free kick procedure
body: Second touch before goal; signal by referee.

title: Free Kicks — Free kick offences
body: Encroachment, delay, failure to respect distance.

body: IFAB Law 14 — The Penalty Kick. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: The Penalty Kick — Penalty kick
body: Awarded for DFK offences inside the penalty area.

title: The Penalty Kick — Procedure
body: Mark, goalkeeper on line, other players outside area and arc.

title: The Penalty Kick — Offences and sanctions
body: Encroachment, feinting, goalkeeper movement.

title: The Penalty Kick — Kicks from the penalty mark
body: Shoot-out procedure.

title: The Throw-in — Procedure
body: Both feet on or behind the line; from point where ball left field.

title: The Throw-in — Offences and sanctions
body: Foul throw; incorrect position.

title: The Goal Kick
body: IFAB Law 16 — The Goal Kick. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: The Goal Kick — Procedure
body: From anywhere inside goal area; opponents outside penalty area.

title: The Goal Kick — Offences and sanctions
body: Ball not in play; encroachment.

title: The Corner Kick
body: IFAB Law 17 — The Corner Kick. Governs play in Premier League matches.

title: The Corner Kick — Procedure
body: Attacker takes from corner arc; opponents 9.15 m away.

title: The Corner Kick — Offences and sanctions
body: Encroachment; incorrectly taken corner.

title: Mistaken identity
body: Correct player cautioned or sent off when the wrong offender was identified.

title: Goal/no goal — offside
body: Offside in the build-up or at goal may be reviewed; factual line decisions use VAR-only review where appropriate.

title: Penalty / no penalty
body: Location of offence, handball or foul in the box, and incorrect award or missed penalty.

title: VAR protocol principles
body: VAR assists only for clear and obvious errors or serious missed incidents; the referee always decides.

title: Principles (1–12)
body: Independent VAR access; referee must make an initial decision; accuracy over speed.

title: Reviewable decisions
body: Goal/no goal, penalty/no penalty, direct red card (not second yellow), mistaken identity.

title: Clear and obvious error — red-card review
body: VAR reviews direct red-card offences including serious foul play; overturn only for clear and obvious error.

title: Procedures
body: Check, review, on-field review (OFR), VAR-only review, communication to players.

title: Added time (Premier League)
body: Additional time announced for stoppages including VAR checks, substitutions and injuries.

title: Premier League — Laws of the Game
body: Premier League matches are played under IFAB Laws of the Game and FIFA statutes unless competition rules state otherwise.

title: Disciplinary process
body: FA/PGMOL disciplinary commissions for cards, misconduct and post-match review.

body: Bench size, concussion substitutes and substitution windows per Premier League competition rules.

body: Behaviour of coaches and staff; sanctions aligned with Law 12 team official offences.

body: Premier League application of IFAB handball criteria for penalty decisions.

body: Marginal offside and goal decisions; SAOT technology where deployed in Premier League.

title: Penalty decisions
body: VAR checks for penalty-area offences, handball and foul leading to penalty awards or misses.
